_comment: Documented quality baselines for the mocked eval corpus (FOOD-58).
`baseline` is what the current fixtures score on the current pipeline with the
current model tiers (Opus 5 for receipt.*, Sonnet 5 for meal.*). `min`/`max` is
the CI gate: the suite fails when a metric crosses it. Thresholds sit one
fixture-level miss below the baseline on purpose, so a single regression in a
pipeline guard or a re-recorded lower-tier response is enough to fail.
Re-baseline in the same PR as the change that moves a number, and say why.

ingredient_match_routing_on._comment: Same corpus with MODEL_ROUTING_ENABLED=true (Sonnet first, Opus on low-confidence escalation). Decisions must not move; the Opus share is the cost lever the flag buys.

prompt_layout._comment: Live-only (FOOD-56 residual): cached system+tail vs legacy single-turn prompt must reach the same pantry-match decision.
